# testless

> Cut your test time to the minimum. Run 5 tests instead of 500 by reading your code, not your coverage.

testless parses your repo into a function-level graph with tree-sitter, diffs changes structurally (comments and formatting are free), and walks the graph to find every test a change could break. It prints your runner's own CLI invocations, ready to execute.

## Guarantee

Selection is always a superset of the truly impacted tests. testless widens instead of guessing, and never silently skips a test that could fail.

## Install

| Ecosystem | Command |
|---|---|
| JS / TS | `npm i -D testless-cli` (bin: `testless`) |
| Go | `curl -fsSL https://testless.itaywol.tools/install.sh \| sh` or `brew install itaywol/testless/testless` |
| Rust | `cargo binstall testless` or `cargo install testless` |

Prebuilt binaries: https://github.com/itaywol/testless/releases
Nix flake repo: `nix develop`

## Commands

```bash
testless index                                    # build the graph (.testless/)
testless select --from <rev> [--to <rev>] [--format json|text|args]  # tests impacted by changes
testless changes                                  # functions the static AST diff detected as changed
testless why <test-id>                             # explains why a specific test was selected
```

`select` output is JSON when piped, human-readable text on a TTY. On fallback-to-everything, `--format args` prints nothing and exits with code 2, so scripts should branch on the exit code:

```bash
testless select --from origin/main --format args > cmds.txt || RUN_ALL=1
```

## Config

Optional `testless.toml` at the repo root, for the cases static inference cannot cover:

```toml
always-run = ["tests/smoke/**", "**/*.e2e.test.ts"]  # always select these tests
ignore = ["**/generated/**", "*.pb.go"]               # never index these files
```

## Languages

| Language | Test runner support |
|---|---|
| TypeScript / JavaScript | vitest, jest `-t` patterns |
| Go | `go test -run` |
| Rust | `cargo test` |

A new language is roughly one plugin file, see CONTRIBUTING.md in the repository.

## Real-repo numbers

| Repo | Change | testless selects | Indexing time |
|---|---|---|---|
| withastro/astro | Markdoc transform fix | 6 of 6,121 tests | 3.1s |
| gin-gonic/gin | Panic-recovery fix | 18 of 674 tests | 0.3s |
| openclaw/openclaw | Full index | 106,594 tests across 22,797 files | 86s cold, then incremental |

Live recordings of these runs rotate on https://testless.itaywol.tools

## Status

Young project. The selection engine works end to end on all three languages, precision improves release by release. Roadmap lives in GitHub issues.
